title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Strawberry Banana Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Looking for a deliciously fruity and refreshing vaping experience? Look no further than Strawberry Banana Ice by Vice, the latest addition to the Vice brand’s premium line of salt nicotine e-liquids.
Crafted with the same commitment to quality and attention to detail as Vice’s high-performance disposable vapes, this e-liquid delivers a smooth and satisfying vaping experience that’s perfect for both beginners and experienced vapers alike.
Experience the perfect blend of sweet and juicy strawberries and creamy bananas, with a cool and refreshing icy finish. Made with high-quality ingredients and available in a convenient 30ml bottle, Strawberry Banana Ice by Vice is the perfect choice for those seeking a delicious and satisfying vape.
Whether you’re looking to quit smoking and switch to vaping or simply looking to explore new and exciting flavors, Strawberry Banana Ice by Vice is the perfect choice for you. Try it today and discover the ultimate in vaping pleasure!
Flavour Notes:
Strawberry
Banana
Ice
Vice E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
